blocks.content: The expenses, including salaries, allowances, and pensions payable to constitutional authorities, shall be charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India.

items: Salaries charged on the Consolidated Fund of India can be discussed in Parliament but are NOT subject to vote.
The Chief Election Commissioner and CAG are removed in the same manner and on the same grounds as a Judge of the Supreme Court.
The Chairman of UPSC is ineligible for any further employment under the Government of India or a State after retirement.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Tenure for key constitutional posts such as CAG, CEC, and UPSC Chairman is generally fixed at 6 years or until reaching 65 years of age, whichever is earlier.
Salaries, allowances, and pensions of constitutional heads are charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India and are non-votable by Parliament.
Service conditions and salary cannot be varied to the disadvantage of the incumbent after appointment.
Removal usually requires an order of the President passed after a formal address by both Houses of Parliament with a special majority.
